body.condition: For every \(i\in[n]\), distinct points \(z,z'\in Z_{\theta i}\) satisfy \(\operatorname{dist}_{\mathbb T}(z,z')\ge\Delta_0\).

novel.justification: A fixed separation prevents critical neighborhoods from coalescing as the law varies, which would create an additional unresolved scale in a uniform modulus. Fixed-degree Fourier contrasts and periodic splines with separated knots satisfy the condition.
